description: Premium Google AI tool announced for all NTU undergraduates from August 2026.
howToObtain: Official announcement covers all NTU undergraduates from August 2026; current individual account activation and licence conditions were not independently tested. Follow assessment instructions separately.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: from August 2026, NTU will give all undergraduates full access to a suite of premium Google AI tools , such as Gemini Enterprise, Google AI Studio, and Vertex AI.

description: NTU-built course AI-tutor platform for educators.
howToObtain: Educators build and deploy course tutors; availability depends on the applicable course. This does not grant general assessment permission.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: the University has built the NTU AI Learning Assistant (NALA), a platform that enables educators to develop AI tutors. These AI tutors are trained on course materials to help students address their own learning gaps around the clock, in a way that suits how they learn.
